applicationName.description: Optional explicit name for the rendered ArgoCD Application. Defaults to a per-cluster derived name to avoid collisions when deployed to multiple clusters.

destination.description: Argo destination for the rendered Application. Provide `server` (cluster URL) or `name` (registered cluster name). Must resolve to the WORKLOAD cluster: kured reboots the nodes it runs on.

period.description: How often the sentinel is checked, Go duration (e.g. 1h).

rebootDays.description: Days a reboot may happen. Empty = every day.

concurrency.description: Nodes rebooting at the same time.

drainTimeout.description: Go duration after which the drain is aborted; empty = wait forever.

forceReboot.description: Reboot even when the drain failed or timed out.

drainGracePeriod.description: Seconds per pod to terminate; -1 = the pod's own terminationGracePeriod.

extraValues.description: Deep-merged on top of the computed values passed to the upstream chart.
